description: This file is a shell script that performs automated testing for a Git and Subversion (svn) integration, specifically testing svn refspec globbing functionality with git svn multi-fetch commands. It sets up svn repositories, makes commits, configures git remotes with glob patterns, and verifies the correctness of the git svn fetch operations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success; runs the provided commands and verifies their success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands expecting failure; verifies that the commands fail as expected.
